title: For-Advocate Brief Output (engage-lexicon)
description: Schema for the structured report returned by the for-advocate subagent in engage-lexicon. Mirrors /debate-prism for-brief-schema.json and requires `jurisdiction` (propagated from the gate). Citations conform to the extended citation-schema.json with authorityType and authorityWeight.

claim.description: The directional legal claim under debate, restated by the advocate. Must match the claim in the brief.

jurisdiction.description: The declared jurisdiction. Propagated from the jurisdiction-declared gate; the advocate treats this as authoritative.

corePosition.description: One-to-two-sentence best-supported version of the claim the advocate is defending, framed within {jurisdiction}.

citations.description: Ordered list of citations. Every non-derived claim in analysis[] must reference an index. Each citation must include authorityType and authorityWeight.

citesIndices.description: Indices into citations[] that support this step.

derivedFrom.description: Step numbers this claim derives from.

attemptedCalls.description: Documentation of attempted calls. Required non-empty when performed=false.

recommendation.description: Direct recommendation given only the for-case, framed in the educational-only register (not as legal advice). Honest about limits of the data and the limits of automated legal analysis.

degradationEvidence.description: Set to 'unverified' when the advocate claimed webResearch.performed=false with zero attemptedCalls[] after a re-dispatch.
